svg.title: Validation accuracy versus training GPU-hours
svg.desc: Qwen3-8B on MIA and Agent×3. Original measured curves for SFT, Soft-KD, Offline-MOPD, and MOPD from Figure 3 of arXiv:2610.04272v1. GPU-hours use a logarithmic axis; outlined markers indicate the best retained validation checkpoints. Training costs exclude teacher-corpus generation and evaluation.
